messages.subject: Project Aquilo - Master Supply Agreement (first draft)
messages.plaintextBody:
Robert, Hannah,

Following agreement of the heads of terms, please find attached our first draft of the Master Manufacture and Supply Agreement for the Harrow/Calderwater framework. The technical specification, service levels and pricing are dealt with in separate schedules which we'll circulate shortly.

We look forward to receiving your client's comments.

Kind regards,

Elena Marchetti
Associate | Whitfield Carter LLP
T +44 (0)20 7946 0048
whitfieldcarter.com
